entries.summary: FDA warns that excess acetaminophen can cause severe liver injury.
entries.population_notes: Read the acetaminophen overview and product labeling for the context of this warning. Source reading: https://www.fda.gov/drugs/safe-use-over-counter-pain-relievers-and-fever-reducers/acetaminophen

entries.summary: Acetaminophen can appear in more than one medicine, creating a risk of unintentional overlap.
entries.population_notes: The consumer page discusses ingredient labels and overlapping acetaminophen products. Source reading: https://www.fda.gov/consumers/consumer-updates/dont-overuse-acetaminophen

entries.summary: FDA pain-reliever education identifies ibuprofen as an NSAID and discusses kidney and stomach-bleeding risks.
entries.population_notes: The brochure describes risks for some people with medical conditions; it does not establish individual suitability. Source reading: https://www.fda.gov/drugs/safe-use-over-counter-pain-relievers-and-fever-reducers/best-way-take-your-over-counter-pain-reliever-seriously-four-panel-brochure

entries.summary: MedlinePlus lists serious gastrointestinal warnings for ibuprofen, including ulcers and bleeding.
entries.population_notes: Read the full drug-information warning for the risk context and the populations it discusses. Source reading: https://medlineplus.gov/druginfo/meds/a682159.html

entries.summary: The CDC school-nutrition resource discusses caffeine and other stimulants in energy drinks used by students.
entries.population_notes: Scope: school nutrition and energy drinks. Read the source for the populations and concerns it discusses. Source reading: https://www.cdc.gov/school-nutrition/energy-drinks/index.html

entries.summary: FDA describes differences in caffeine sensitivity related to individual factors, health conditions and medicines.
entries.population_notes: The page discusses caffeine from multiple consumer sources; no personal intake limit is established in this record. Source reading: https://www.fda.gov/consumers/consumer-updates/spilling-beans-how-much-caffeine-too-much

notes: Population-level public health information. Not medical advice.
